title: Establishment of a research infrastructure to investigate health care delivery, quality of care and the development of care in lung and breast cancer centres certified by the German Cancer Society
summary: Cancer centres certified by the German Cancer Society (DKG) document extensive data during treatment. These data are to be used for research in the future. Patients treated in certified lung and breast cancer centres are asked to consent to the transfer of their treatment data in pseudonymised form (without name or address) to the DKG. There, the data are stored and analysed upon request to answer questions about cancer care, such as diagnoses, treatments, complications and survival. The results are intended to inform guidelines and certification requirements and to improve cancer care.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of bronchus and lung

interventions.name: Care data collected during the diagnosis and treatment of patients in certified lung and breast cancer centres, no retrospective data

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All adult patients of a participating certified lung or breast cancer centre who provide consent to data processing are included.
Exclusion criteria:
Insufficient language skills or cognitive impairments that prevent understanding of the patient information and consent form (as determined by the treating team)
